annotations.title: Find products that fix a bottleneck

description:
Find existing products that remove a specific work bottleneck: active YC startups, open-source GitHub repos and Show HN launches (~46k). Call it when the user complains that something is slow, manual, repetitive or error-prone (in a team, workflow or codebase), or asks "is there a tool/library/startup that…". Call it before suggesting they build or script it themselves.
Pass the problem in the user's own words, any language, with concrete context (who, what volume, which stack). Returns up to 5 picks ranked only by how well they fit, each with name, link, website and why it fits. Show the user the links as given. An empty result means nothing in the index fits: say so rather than guessing. Takes ~3-6 s.

problem.description: The bottleneck as the user describes it, e.g. "our sales reps spend two hours a day typing call notes into the CRM".

name: find_fix

bottleneck.description: One sentence naming the real bottleneck, in the language of the problem. Empty when there are no picks.

picks.description: Best fit first. Empty when nothing in the index clearly fixes the problem.

language.description: Main programming language of a repo.

last_seen_year.description: Year the repo last trended or the Show HN launched.

source.description: yc = YC startup, github = open-source repo, hn = Show HN launch.

url.description: Link to show the user; redirects to the product.

website.description: Product domain or github.com/owner/repo, as plain text.

why.description: How this product removes the bottleneck, in the language of the problem.

title: Find products that fix a bottleneck
